reden: Not detected. The report’s High issue focuses on a unit/decimals mismatch in executeLiquidate() when computing liquidatorReward (mixing borrow-token units with collateral-token units). The described vulnerability H-03 concerns an incorrect collateral remainder cap calculation (using crLiquidation instead of crLiquidation - 100%), which inflates the cap and unfairly increases protocol fees for higher-CR users. These are different sub-calculations with different fixes; correcting the unit mismatch would not address the remainder-cap formula error. None of the other report items cover the remainder-cap issue either.
